1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 c5 3.Nf3 d5 4.cxd5.strategy: Settles the tension in the centre at once: White removes the pawn that attacks c4 and, once Black recaptures, can attack the knight on d5 with the knight on c3. The simplest way to a healthy game, trading a flank pawn for a central one.

1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 c5 3.Nf3 d5 4.cxd5 Nxd5.strategy: Recaptures with the knight, which develops and in turn attacks the knight on c3. The piece is centralised but also a target, so White can challenge it at once; Black accepts that for easy development and a firm hold on the centre.
